bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears opened the 2026 season with a franchise-record performance, setting a franchise record for points in a season opener in a 59-37 win over the Panthers . Quarterback Caleb Williams shined with a strong all-around effort while D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai both ran for 100-plus yards, marking the first time since 1980 and only the eighth time in NFL history that a team had two players rush for at least 100 yards in their season opener .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are dealing with injury updates following their Week 1 overtime win over the New Orleans Saints, as running back Isiah Pacheco underwent back surgery Monday and is expected to be sidelined roughly 12 weeks, giving him a chance to return in December. Meanwhile, offensive lineman Christian Mahogany's knee imaging came back negative after he was ruled out with a lower-body injury in the first half of Sunday's victory, though the results appear to have ruled out significant damage , even as Dan Campbell cautioned the team isn't "out of the woods" yet, suggesting Mahogany may be dealing with a hip injury ahead of Thursday night's game against the Buffalo Bills .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers suffered a stunning collapse in their Week 1 opener, blowing a 22-10 lead in the third quarter to lose 39-22 to the Minnesota Vikings, with critics pointing to head coach Matt LaFleur's play-calling, game and clock management as factors that cost the team down the stretch . The loss has intensified scrutiny on the franchise, as the Packers find themselves right where they left off last season, in yet another collapse , raising questions about the team's ability to close out games in 2026.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings kicked off their 2026 season with a dominant 39-22 win over the Green Bay Packers, but the victory was overshadowed by starting quarterback Kyler Murray exiting the game with a concussion after a hit from safety Javon Bullard. Despite the scary injury, backup Carson Wentz stepped in and threw three touchdowns to help secure the road win.
